Google Cloud Summits · Europe and beyond

Book meetings at Google Cloud Summits with local cloud buyers and partners.

Google Cloud Summits are regional events that bring a country's Google Cloud customers and partners together for a day. They're smaller than Google Cloud Next, and much easier to stand out at with a plan.

Book Google Cloud Summit meetings with A8Z

How do you book meetings at a Google Cloud Summit? Start 4-6 weeks before the Summit. Build a list of cloud, data, AI and platform leaders at target accounts in that country, plus local Google Cloud partners. Reach them by email, LinkedIn and phone with a reason to meet, and offer short meetings at the venue or nearby. A8Z runs this end to end for B2B software vendors.

Why Google Cloud Summits work for small teams

Country-level audiences

Each Summit gathers one market's Google Cloud customers, which makes it easy to focus on the region you're trying to grow in.

Partner-heavy

Local Google Cloud partners and resellers attend in force. They're often the fastest route into that market's deals.

Less noise than Next

Fewer vendors competing for attention means well-targeted outreach stands out.

Who we reach for you at Google Cloud Summits

  • CTOs, cloud architects, data, AI and platform leaders at target accounts in the Summit's country
  • Attendees we find through social listening who post about going to the Summit and match your ICP
  • Local Google Cloud partners, resellers and service providers
  • Technology vendors you integrate with, for co-selling and Google Cloud Marketplace partnerships

Google publishes each year's Summit cities and dates. In 2026 the EMEA series included London, Paris, Frankfurt (DACH), Stockholm (Nordics), Tel Aviv, Prague, Milan and Amsterdam. For Google's flagship event, see Google Cloud Next meeting booking.

Google Cloud Summit meeting booking questions

What is a Google Cloud Summit?

Google Cloud Summits are regional events run by Google Cloud in cities around the world, usually for one day, for local customers and partners. They are smaller and more local than Google Cloud Next.

Which Google Cloud Summits do you book meetings for?

Summits in Europe, Israel and the US, such as London, Paris, Frankfurt (DACH), Stockholm (Nordics) and Tel Aviv.

When should we start booking meetings for a Google Cloud Summit?

4-6 weeks before the Summit. Several European Summits often fall within a few weeks of each other, so plan the whole series together.

Can you cover several Summits in one season?

Yes. We run outreach per city, with a local target list and partner track for each Summit.

Planning your Google Cloud Summit season?

Tell us the cities and your ICP. We'll show you how many relevant attendees we can reach in each.
